about: Written by scripts/read-menus.mjs. Menus come from each restaurant’s own website.

places.name: Uni3 World of Food

items.text: Water: Bakad fisk - wasabimajonnäs - gröna ärtor - kokt potatis – dill - tomatsmörsås
Fire: Kebabkryddad kycklinglårfilé - kryddkokt ris – sallad – tomat - lök - feferoni – röd sås - vit sås (veg alternativ)
Metal: Rosastekt fläskkarré - cidergräddsås - rostad potatis - bränd äppelkräm - pepparrot – persilja
Earth: Pokebowl – sushiris – friterad glaserad tofu – marinerad sojaböna - inlagd rödkål - chilimajo - jordnötscrumble

places.note: Earth is the vegetarian station.

places.name: Kooperativet
places.includes: salad buffet, bread, coffee and cake

items.text: Veckans special: Kooperativets Kimchi Ramen – Udonnudlar i svamp & miso buljong toppas med wokad kyckling, kimchi, böngroddar och koriander, serveras med bakat ägg
Veckans special: Kooperativets Kimchi Ramen – Udonnudlar i svamp & miso buljong toppas med wokad tofu, kimchi, böngroddar och koriander, serveras med bakat ägg
Kött: Kooperativets klassiska Köttbullemåndag på nötfärs med potatispuré, svampsås, rårörda lingon & pressgurka
Fisk: Lättrimmad torsk serveras med dillkokt potatis, skaldjurssås, gröna ärtor samt citron och örter
Thai: Panang curry – wokad kyckling & lök i panangcurry med kokosmjölk smaksatt med limeblad serveras med jasminris & koriander
Indisk: Murgh Masala indisk gryta med kyckling serveras med basmatiris, mangochutney, smörat Naan och koriander
Världen: Klassisk Svenne Carbonara – Spagetti i Krämig carbonarasås med äggula toppad med massa bacon & parmesan samt ruccola
Vegetarisk: Panang curry – wokad tofu & lök i panangcurry med kokosmjölk smaksatt med limeblad serveras med jasminris & koriander

places.name: Bistrot
places.includes: salad buffet, sourdough bread, coffee and cake

items.text: Kalvfärsbiff · Gräddsås – Sirapssauterad Kål & morötter – Lingon – Potatispuré
Pankostekt fångst Saffransaioli – Bakad cocktailtomat – Rostad potatis – Rucola
Veckans: Fläsklägg · Rotmos – Pepparrotsås – Senap – Persilja
Gnocchi · Kantareller – Spetskål – Brynt smör – Västerbottenostkräm – Rucola

places.name: Cuckoo's Nest
places.includes: salad buffet, coffee, tea and cake

items.text: Ugnsbakat kalkonbröst serveras med rotfrukter, haricot verts, grönkål och rödvinssås
risotto serveras med rostade tomater, mandelflakes, grönkål och grana padanao

places.name: Oishii
places.note: Sushi, ramen, bento and poke bowls. Same menu every day, vegetarian sushi available.

places.name: District One
places.includes: homemade bread, salad buffet, coffee and cake

items.text: Fisk: Pocherad torskfile med ägg och persiljesås, serveras med rostad morot och potatismos.
Kött: Köttbullar på kalvfärs med gräddsås och rårörda lingon, serveras med pressgurka och potatismos.
Fried chicken: Friterad kyckling med chili mayo och jordnötssås, serveras med morot och vitkålssallad samt jasminris.
Vegetarisk: Friterad dumplings med chili mayo och jordnötssås, serveras med morot och vitkålssallad samt jasminris.
Poke bowl: Ponzu marinerad lax eller räkor med sesamfrön, sushiris, romansallad, sojabönor, rädisa, picklad rödlök, mango och avokado, serveras med chili majo och koriander.
Vegetarisk Poke bowl: Tofu med sesamfrön, sushiris, romansallad, sojabönor, rädisa, picklad rödlök, mango och avokado, serveras med chili majo och koriander.
Pho: Vietnamesisk nudelsoppa med biff, koriander, gräslök, lök, böngroddar, chili, thai basilika, serveras med lime, hoisinsås och srirachasås.

places.name: Miss F
places.note: Ciabatta, salads, poke bowls, bibimbap and sushi. Same menu every day, tofu and chèvre options.

places.name: Bombay Bistro
places.note: Indian curries on a four-week rotation, plus a daily vegetarian thali (can be made vegan).

places.name: Alkemisten
places.note: Specialty coffee bar with a vegetarian or vegan lunch on weekdays. Their site doesn't list the dishes.

places.name: BISTRO 3
places.note: Pinsa, classic mains, salads and kebab, plus a weekly dish (ask the staff, it isn't on their site). Vegetarian pinsa and Greek salad. Full menu as a picture below.

places.name: Dunder Döner
places.note: Döner kebab and chicken as rolls, pitas, plates with fries or rice, salads and burgers, plus Iskender. Same menu every day, falafel versions of most dishes. Weekday lunch 10.30–14.00 includes a drink and coffee.

places.name: Masala Kitchen
places.includes: lunch naan, rice, salad and water

items.text: Tandoori Tikka Boti · kycklingfilé marinerad i lime, yoghurt och tandoori masala, i tandoorisås
Lamb Punjabi Curry · lamm i sås av lök, tomat, paprika, ingefära, koriander och grön chili
Baingan Mirch Masala · aubergine, paprika, tomat, kryddor och koriander

places.note: Menu 4 of 4 this week. Always on: Subzi thali 139 kr (can be made vegan), palak paneer 139 kr, butter chicken, rogan josh and more, 139–165 kr.

places.name: Mimolett
places.note: Italian: risotto, pasta, lasagne, fish gratin, burger and entrecôte, all 129 kr. Same list every day (their own site is gone; menu via Menydags). Penne Vegetale and Penne Pesto are vegetarian. Takeaway 115 kr.

places.name: BENNE Pastabar
places.note: Fresh pasta in eight sauces, same menu all day. Slow Tomato (vegan without cheese), Västerbotten cheese and truffle mushroom are vegetarian.

places.name: Gansu Köket
places.note: Western Chinese: Lanzhou beef noodle soup, dumplings, xiao long bao and other noodles. Same menu every day, vegetarian options. Lindholmsallén 8C.

places.name: Smash-N-Go
places.note: Smash burgers (food truck) with fries, onion rings and mozzarella sticks. Same menu every day, no vegetarian burger. No website, so the link goes to their foodora page.

places.name: Shiro
places.note: Japanese fusion: sushi, maki rolls and poke bowls, à la carte (no separate lunch deal on their site). Vegan tofu poke bowl.

places.name: Karla Bakeshop
places.note: Asian fusion bistro and bakery by Karlatornet: poke bowls, salads, pasta, pizza, sandwiches and husman. Same menu every day; their site doesn't say which dishes are vegetarian.

places.name: Pizza di Ciro
places.note: Neapolitan pizza. Lunch pizzas: Margherita (vegetarian), Vesuvio, Capricciosa, Diavola, Kebab and Bacon. Kuskens Gata 3.

places.name: Bar Schiacciate
places.note: Tuscan schiacciata sandwiches, half or whole: mortadella, 'nduja, prosciutto, tuna, roast beef, turkey Caesar. Same menu every day; Caprese (pesto, mozzarella, tomato) is vegetarian. Lindholmsallén 22C.

places.name: Brunchoteket
places.note: Breakfast and brunch all day, 09–17: eggs Benedict, pancakes, bowls, shakshuka. Same menu every day; their menu is a picture (tap it to see it full size). Lindholmsallén 22A.

places.name: Kapten Nemos
places.includes: salad buffet, 33 cl drink and coffee
places.note: Pizzeria. Lunch weekdays 10–14: pizza no. 1–21, kebab plate, kebab roll or salad for 118 kr; the rest of the menu at its normal price, salad buffet, drink and coffee still included. Falafel dishes on the menu. Karlavagnsgatan 21.

places.name: Picadeli Lindholmen
places.note: Salad bar: build your own salad from a big buffet and pay by weight. Weekdays 10.30–14.00. Their site doesn't give this restaurant's price. Theres Svenssons gata 9.

places.name: Pier 11
places.includes: salad buffet, coffee and soft ice cream

items.text: Kebab spiced soy strips · potato wedges, tzatziki, Naan bread
Pork fillet · lemongrass sauce, pickled onions salad, fried rice
Baked cod · Duchess potato, Champagne sauce, Broccoli & red pepper relish

places.note: Ericsson's restaurant, open to everyone. Three dishes a day, one usually vegetarian; menu in English.

places.name: Restaurang Äran
places.note: Daily lunch specials 11–14, salad and bread buffet with every dish. They don't publish the menu online, so the link goes to Lindholmen Science Park's page about them. Diagonalen 6.

places.name: L's Kitchen
places.note: Food court with five dishes a day (fish, meat, salad and a vegetarian main) plus Caesar salad and a weekly salad, 11.00–13.30. The day's menu is only on a screen there. Pay with a guest card from the cashier. Lindholmspiren 5.

places.name: Ha Long Bay
places.note: Vietnamese and pan-Asian: spring rolls, pho and noodle soups, banh mi, pad thai, curry, bibimbap and poke bowls. Same menu every day; the link goes to their online ordering page. Lindholmspiren 9.

places.name: Lindholmens Pizzeria
places.note: Weekday lunch 10.30–14.00: a pizza (nos. 1–21), the daily pasta, lasagne, a burger, falafel or kebab. Same menu every day, vegetarian pizzas and falafel. Lindholmsvägen 1.

places.name: Sushi Yama
places.note: Sushi combos, rolls, poke bowls, dumplings and bento. Same lunch menu every day, weekdays until 14.00, with vegan tofu bowls and a vegan combo. Lindholmspiren 5, next to Pressbyrån.

places.name: Subway
places.note: Build your own sub or salad, plus panini subs. Same menu every day, open every day 10–19. Lindholmsallén 34.

places.name: Lindholmens Kebab
places.note: Kebab, chicken and falafel as rolls, pitas, plates and salads (plates and salads come with bread). Same menu every day, weekdays 10–16, with vegan versions. No website, so the link goes to their foodora page. Lindholmsallén 31.

places.name: Holy Greens
places.note: Salads and hot bowls (bowls from 10.00), such as Holy Caesar, Laxokado, Seoul and Thai-ish. Same menu every day, vegan versions with vegobites; drinks cost extra. Götaverksgatan 35.

places.name: Esters Salutorg
places.note: Run by the restaurant students at Ester Mosessons gymnasium: takeaway meals, sandwiches, bread, pastries and fika. Weekdays about 10–14.30 in term time, closed in school holidays. The menu is only on the school's Instagram and no price is given. Lärdomsgatan 5.

places.name: Café Norra Älvstranden
places.note: Student café on the Lindholmen campus: coffee, lunch salads, pasta salad and smoothies. No menu, price or opening hours online, so check before you walk over. Forskningsgången 6.

places.name: TacO's
places.note: Birria tacos with consommé for dipping, burritos and bowls; every dish comes with beef, chicken or a vegetarian filling. Same menu every day. Part of O's Streetfood. Lindholmsallén 8A, by the Pumpgatan bus stop (same building as Uni3).
